profile.details: Junior Full Stack Developer | Video Editor

aboutBubbles: I am a BS Information Technology graduate with hands-on experience building modern web applications using React.js, Next.js, Laravel, and database technologies. I enjoy creating responsive, user-friendly systems that solve real-world problems.

Through my experience at INFOSOFT and personal projects, I have worked with frontend-backend integration, REST APIs, MySQL, Supabase, Docker, Git/GitHub, deployment workflows, and modern development practices.

I have over 2 years of professional video editing experience creating short-form and long-form content for YouTube, social media, and AI-generated videos. My focus is delivering engaging content that keeps viewers watching.

I use Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects to create clean edits, smooth transitions, motion graphics, and strong storytelling. I continuously improve my editing style to achieve better pacing, retention, and overall viewer experience.
